skills.description: Perform a deep competitive analysis for a solopreneur business. Use when mapping competitors in detail, finding exploitable gaps, understanding competitor strategy, benchmarking your own offering, or deciding how to position against the field. Trigger on "analyze my competitors", "competitive analysis", "who are my competitors", "competitor deep-dive", "how do I beat the competition", "competitive landscape", "benchmark against competitors".
